name: protenix_v1_fold
description: Predict an all-atom biomolecular structure with Protenix 1.1.0, ByteDance's open AlphaFold3 reproduction. The query is a list of chains, each with a molecule_type (protein, dna, rna, ligand or ion) and a sequence -- SMILES or CCD_<id> for a ligand. Returns per-sample confidence scores (rank on ranking_score) and timings; the mmCIF text itself is opt-in. No MSA search is performed: pass alignments on a chain for an MSA-fed prediction.

sequence.description: Residue sequence; SMILES or CCD_<id> when molecule_type is 'ligand'; the element symbol when it is 'ion'.

count.description: Identical copies of this chain in the complex (default 1).

unpairedMsa.description: A3M text of the unpaired MSA for this chain. Nothing is searched for: this is the only way the provider gets one.

pairedMsa.description: A3M text of the paired MSA.

unpairedMsaPath.description: Path to an A3M file readable by the worker, instead of inline text.

pairedMsaPath.description: Path to a paired A3M file.

name.description: A label for this complex; it names the output files. Defaults to 'complex'.

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed reproduces the prediction. Upstream's default is 101.

num_diffusion_samples.description: Structures to sample (upstream's default is 5). Each is scored separately, so this is how to compare conformations; rank them on `scores`.

num_diffusion_steps.description: Diffusion steps per sample (upstream's default is 200). Fewer is faster and coarser.

num_recycles.description: Pairformer recycling cycles (upstream's default is 10). Fewer is faster and less accurate.

out_dir.description: Write the predicted structures to this directory on the server instead of a temporary one, and return their paths. This is how to get a structure larger than the transport can carry, and how to hand one provider's output to another's input without the mmCIF making a round trip through the caller.

return_structures.description: Return the mmCIF text (default false: megabytes). The confidence scores come back either way.

structure_paths.description: Server-side mmCIF paths, when out_dir was given.

out_dir.description: The directory the structures were written to.
